title: Beta cycles represent arbitrary total homology classes
statement: Let X be a separated scheme, U a finite family of opens with every positive tuple intersection affine, I an injective resolution of X.etaleAdditiveSheaf, and n a natural number. For any h in the degree-n homology of additiveCechTotal U I, there are an ordinary unit Cech cycle z and a total cycle t_beta such that iCycles(t_beta)=additiveCechBeta U I n (iCycles(z)) and homologyPi(t_beta)=h. No global cycle, compactness or covering condition is required.

source.place: Theorem 59.22.4, affine-intersection comparison, with the beta augmentation of Tag 01EQ.

proof.text: Obtain the beta quasi-isomorphism b with its fixed components from [lem-pbc-additive-cech-beta-quasi-iso]. Its homology map is invertible. Take the inverse image of h and then a lifted source cycle w using the surjectivity of homologyPi.
Let x be the ULift.down of iCycles(w). The equation iCycles_d=0, after applying ULift.down, says that x is an ordinary unit Cech cocycle. Construct z with cyclesMk and use i_cyclesMk to recover x.

Let t_beta=cyclesMap(b)(w). Naturality cyclesMap_i and the prescribed components of b give the beta inclusion. Naturality of homologyPi, the chosen projection of w, and inv_hom_id give homologyPi(t_beta)=h.

lean.statement:
theorem additiveCech_beta_representative
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.IsSeparated] {ι : Type u} [Finite ι]
    (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι), IsAffineOpen (⨅ l, U (y l)))
    (I : InjectiveResolution X.etaleAdditiveSheaf) (n : ℕ)
    (h : (additiveCechTotal U I).homology n) :
    ∃ (z : (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).cycles n)
      (tβ : (additiveCechTotal U I).cycles n),
      (additiveCechTotal U I).iCycles n tβ = additiveCechBeta U I n
        ((cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).iCycles n z) ∧
      (additiveCechTotal U I).homologyπ n tβ = h
